haiku.problem: The wrong answer 'Holding a wedding feast for a relative from far away' is not false in the passage. Laban prepares a feast for Jacob's wedding (29:22), so it contradicts the verses. The other wrong answer, 'Letting a groom work off the price of his bride,' also describes what happens to Jacob in the passage (29:18-20, 27), so it is not clearly false either.
